question: An annual allowance for wear and tear of a capital good is known as ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** depreciation.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Depreciation refers to the decrease in value of a capital good over time due to wear and tear, obsolescence, or other factors.**
 
• It is an annual allowance that is** deducted from the value of the asset for accounting and tax purposes.**
